tool.description: Create interactive HTML visualization of particle picking results

param.name: input_star
param.label: STAR File

tool.help:
**What it does**
Creates an interactive HTML visualization of CryoEM particle picking results. The visualization allows you to:
- **Zoom and Pan**: Explore the micrograph in detail - **Hover**: See particle information (position, confidence) - **Interactive Plots**: View confidence distributions and spatial patterns - **Export**: Save high-resolution images - **Share**: Send HTML file to collaborators
**📊 Visualization Features**
1. **Main Micrograph View** - Particles overlaid on micrograph - Color-coded by confidence (Viridis colormap) - Zoom to inspect individual particles - Hover to see particle details
2. **Confidence Histogram** - Distribution of confidence scores - Identify quality thresholds - Assess overall detection quality
3. **Spatial Analysis** - Confidence vs position scatter plot - Identify spatial patterns - Detect edge effects
**🎯 Use Cases**
- **Quality Control**: Visually inspect particle picking results - **Parameter Optimization**: Compare different confidence thresholds - **Presentations**: Interactive figures for talks and papers - **Collaboration**: Share results with team members - **Training**: Teach particle picking concepts
**💡 Tips**
1. **Zoom In**: Use scroll wheel or zoom tools to inspect particles 2. **Hover**: Move mouse over particles to see details 3. **Export**: Click camera icon to save high-res PNG 4. **Share**: HTML file is self-contained and portable
**🔧 Requirements**
- Plotly library (installed automatically) - Modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) - Internet connection (for Plotly CDN)
**📁 Input Files**
- **Micrograph**: Original MRC/MRCS/ST file - **STAR File**: Output from Particle Picker Bharat
**📤 Output**
- **HTML File**: Interactive visualization (open in browser)
**🚨 Troubleshooting**
**Visualization doesn't load?** - Check internet connection (needs Plotly CDN) - Try different browser - Check file size (very large files may be slow)
**Particles not visible?** - Check STAR file has data - Verify coordinates are within micrograph bounds - Try zooming in
**⚙️ Technical Details**
- **Library**: Plotly.js for interactive plots - **Format**: Self-contained HTML with embedded data - **Size**: Typically 1-5 MB depending on particle count - **Compatibility**: Works in all modern browsers
**🔗 Workflow Integration**
Typical workflow: 1. Run Particle Picker Bharat 2. Run this tool on the results 3. Open HTML in browser 4. Inspect and validate results 5. Adjust parameters if needed 6. Re-run picking with optimized settings
**📚 Related Tools**
- Particle Picker Bharat: Main particle picking tool - RELION: Downstream 3D reconstruction - CryoSPARC: Alternative reconstruction software
